statement: HUMAIN reports that demand for sovereign, high-performance AI infrastructure continues to grow.
why: Sovereign buyers are an increasingly important marginal source of accelerator demand outside the US hyperscalers.

impact.mechanism: Growing sovereign appetite adds a demand pool that buys full accelerator racks on national timelines rather than cloud capex cycles.

evidence.excerpt: Demand for sovereign, high-performance AI infrastructure continues to grow.

confidence.basis: Primary release, but the claim is a partner executive's qualitative quote with no volumes attached.
